summary: Drilling gains a PeckRetract property and task-panel control that drives the canned-cycle R plane (default SafeHeight, shown only when Strategy is Drilling and Peck is enabled), the ExtraOffset enumeration values are renamed from Drill Tip/2x Drill Tip to Tool Tip/2x Tool Tip with automatic migration, the old RetractHeight migration now renames to PeckRetract instead of folding into StartDepth, inter-hole linking climbs to SafeHeight when PeckRetract is below it, and several property descriptions and panel tooltips are rewritten.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Drilling.py: initCircularHoleOperation adds App::PropertyDistance PeckRetract (default SafeHeight, hidden unless Strategy=Drilling and PeckEnabled); ExtraOffset enumeration 'Drill Tip'/'2x Drill Tip' -> 'Tool Tip'/'2x Tool Tip'; KeepToolDown/PeckDepth/PeckEnabled/ChipBreakEnabled/DwellTime/DwellEnabled descriptions rewritten; _executeDrilling adds explicit climb to SafeHeight between holes when PeckRetract < SafeHeight. PageOpDrillingEdit.ui: new 'Peck retract' Gui::QuantitySpinBox, 'Depth' label -> 'Peck depth', combo items 'Drill tip'/'2x drill tip' -> 'Tool tip'/'2x tool tip'.

Path/Op/Drilling.py: shared Tapping strategy; ExtraOffset enumeration values renamed to 'Tool Tip'/'2x Tool Tip' (explicitly because it applies to Tapping) and the opOnDocumentRestored migration for legacy RetractHeight now renames it to PeckRetract instead of migrating into StartDepth and removing it. PageOpDrillingEdit.ui: ExtraOffset combo item text changed (visible in Tapping panel).
Path/Op/Util.py: drillTipLength only downgrades a log message from error to debug for tools without TipAngle; return value unchanged and the mapping to CAM Area is spurious.

meta.title: CAM Drilling: restore PeckRetract (R) control, safe inter-hole linking
